mark.concept: Two rail-like strokes form an abstract 人. The red heritage/civic stroke and steel-gray AI stroke converge at a civic node. AI nodes remain visually secondary to the public node.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not add a generic red star, hammer-and-sickle motif, flag field or circuit-board texture merely to appear 'red'.
Do not use the mark to imply government approval, official naming or political-organization endorsement.
Do not animate the mark with aggressive neon/glitch effects that undermine the railway/civic material language.

civic_red.meaning: red brick / civic public anchor / railway-labor memory

rail_steel.meaning: technical network / AI interface / rail steel

public_green.meaning: shade, ecology and ordinary public life

architectural_rule: Red is a material family for a very small number of civic anchors, not the default color of the district. AI infrastructure is silver-gray/white, lightweight and removable. Technical lines visually terminate in civic/public nodes.
night_rule: Warm, low-glare civic lighting. No district-scale saturated red wash, laser sky effects or giant LED political spectacle.
communication_rule: Every visual that shows an AI capability should also show at least one of: responsible party, non-AI path, human review, stop/exit, affected user group or claim boundary.
claim_boundary: This is a proposal identity system, not an official Haidian/Beijing government brand or approved project identity.
